items.text: cancel kar do
order radd karo
nahi chahiye abhi

items.context: Kya aap apna order cancel karna chahte hain?
items.text: haan cancel kar do

items.context: Kya main aapka order cancel kar doon?
items.text: order cancel karna hai
theek hai cancel kar do
mera order kal bheja tha usko cancel karna hai
main apna recently place kiya hua order cancel karna chahta hu
kya mera order jiska main payment kar chuka hu cancel ho sakta hai
please mera order number 12345 jaldi cancel kar dijiyega
maine ek galti se galat address dala tha is liye cancel karna hai
agar aap order cancel kar dete to mujhe refund kab milega
order abhi packing me hai to usko cancel karna zaruri hai

items.context: Kya main aapke order ko cancel kar doon?
items.text: haan mera order cancel kar do jaldi

items.context: Kya aap humse apna order cancel karwana chahte hain?
items.text: order cancel karwana hai kyunki mujhe ab nahi chahiye

items.context: Kya aapke order ki cancellation request submit kar du?
items.text: main apne order ki cancellation request kar raha hu

items.context: Aapko kya information chahiye refund ke baare mein?
items.text: kya aap mujhe order cancel hone ke baad refund process bata sakte hain

items.context: Kya aap apna dispatch hone wala order cancel karna chahte hain?
items.text: mera order abhi dispatch nahi hua hai to usse cancel karna hai
mera order last week place hua tha lekin abhi tak deliver nahi hua usse cancel karna hai
kya aap mera order jo maine galti se do baar bheja tha use cancel kar sakte ho
if possible mera order cancel kijiye kyunki address galt likhne ki wajah se delivery possible nahi hoga

items.context: Kyun aap apna order cancel karna chahte hain?
items.text: main order cancel karna chahta hu kyunki mujhe product ki zarurat abhi nahi hai

items.context: Kya aap mujhe order cancellation reason bata sakte hain?
items.text: mera order payment successful tha lekin ab changes ki wajah se cancel karna zaroori ho gaya hai

items.context: Aapko refund process ke baare mein kya jankari chahiye?
items.text: kya aap mujhe refund process ke baare main detail me bata sakte hain agar order cancel karta hu

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: cancel_order - wants to cancel an order
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
